sar.narrative: This report details suspicious online activity involving customer C05061 and card C05061-K1. Between January 12 and January 14, 2017, three unauthorized online transactions totaling $2,189.02 were conducted. The sequence began with transaction 3660106 for $850.28 on January 12, 2017. This was followed by transaction 3660107 for $890.79 on January 13, 2017, and concluded with transaction 3660108 for $447.95 on January 14, 2017. The activity is highly suspicious because the transactions were initiated from a new device utilizing an anonymous proxy to mask its origin. Furthermore, the device signature was spoofed, presenting an impossible combination of an Android handset model (RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K) running Windows 7 and Windows 10 operating systems. This sophisticated device spoofing indicates an intentional effort to bypass security controls. The total exposure for this fraudulent activity is $2,189.02.
